profile: Castle Biosciences is a molecular diagnostics company offering tests to aid clinicians in diagnosing and treating dermatologic cancers, Barrett’s esophagus, uveal melanoma, and atopic dermatitis. Its portfolio includes tissue-based tests that characterize patient biology and provide information relevant to diagnosis, risk assessment, treatment, and patient management. The company serves clinicians in dermatology, gastroenterology, and ophthalmology.
